# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Do not modify files under the oqtane.framework folder in this workspace; treat them as read-only. Confidence 0.93.

## Migration Guidelines
- Use module-version-aligned migration IDs for future migrations, e.g. [Migration("GIBS.Module.IPGuard.01.00.02.00")] instead of incrementing the last segment as a patch counter.
